apps.name: RagaMentor-iOS
apps.versionDescription: v1.5.15 — A Blend slider in the Varisai playback card (below Tempo, 0–60%) tunes the note-blending live while you calibrate it by ear; the value persists and also shapes the Raga scale. Also carries v1.5.14: playing a raga stops a LoopLab song, and background playback is properly enabled (a real Info.plist now carries the audio background mode).
apps.localizedDescription: RagaMentor native: LoopLab — slow down songs, keep pitch, loop sections. Built by GitHub Actions + fastlane on every push to main.
